description.value:
Your sweat numbs.

Gift — Creatures grabbing or swallowing you take a −1 circumstance penalty to their attacks and Athletics against you. Tithe — Skin-to-skin contact tingles unpleasantly: handshakes, Medicine checks on allies without gloves, and disguises that need touch all get awkward (GM adjudicates, usually a −1).

cinderfall.incomplete: "Creatures grabbing or swallowing you take a −1 circumstance penalty to their attacks and Athletics against you" has no rule-element equivalent: it modifies another creature's roll from this actor's own passive trait -- the same architecture gap as Grave-Quiet/Root-of-the-First-Fire.
